title: A Type Confusion has been found in the dns_to_dnsp_convert() function in dnsdata.c of the DNS server… (CVE-2026-125633)
description: A type confusion vulnerability exists in the dns_to_dnsp_convert() function of the DNS server RPC module in the Samba package. This flaw allows a low-privileged network attacker or user in the DnsAdmins group to add a crafted HINFO record via the DNS management interface, causing the directory process handling the request to crash repeatedly. Each crash delays the restart of the process, potentially leading to a denial of service by making the directory remote-call service unavailable. The vulnerability affects Samba versions 4.0.0 and later when the Active Directory Domain Controller (AD DC) DNS server RPC module is enabled. Red Hat products compiled without AD DC support are not affected.
